description: Paid: 0.02 USDC per call via x402 (exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet, eip155:8453). Returns the one-page master checklist (section 1 of the AI Agent Setup Checklist v1.4, 978 words) as Markdown text, verbatim: yes/no checks starting with what always needs the owner's yes (money, public or irreversible actions, owner-only credentials), then launch, accounts, 2FA, tokens, admins, releases, paid routes and test buying. Use it when you want the whole rule set behind check_owner_approval on one page. Without payment the call returns an x402 PaymentRequired result (isError true; structuredContent holds x402Version and accepts); retry with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Takes no input. Same bytes as GET /sections/master-checklist (sha256 5e7720f1938ddfb9c14c51c44b4513d449499509000f75feae8012378212ff3d, 5650 bytes). Full edition: 0.75 USDC at GET /checklist. One-time, sold as-is, no updates.
